newsitem.title: USA: Giant sets stock purchase of Phoenix Fuel.
newsitem.headline: Giant sets stock purchase of Phoenix Fuel.

text.p: Giant Industries Inc said it is to buy Arizona fuel distributor Phoenix Fuel Co for stock in a deal which Giant said would contribute $7-8 million in earnings before tax, interest and depreciation in the first 12 months.

Phoenix has fuel sales of 16,000 barrels per day and owns and operates a lubricant storage and distribution facility, nine bulk petroleum distribution plants and twenty cardlock fueling operations throughout the state of Arizona.
Terms of the stock purchase were not disclosed.

"When completed, this acquisition will expand Giant's primary market further into the fast growing central and southern Arizona markets and will compliment Giant's market in Northern Arizona," Giant said in a statement.
Giant, a refiner and marketer of petroleum products, said the transaction would close on June 2.
Most of Giant's assets are in New Mexico, where it owns refineries, a 300 mile crude oil gathering pipeline system, an ethanol plant in Portales, a finished products terminal and trucks.

It also owns retail service stations and convenience stores in New Mexico, Colorado and Arizona, and recently announced an agreement to purchase 96 additional retail units in Arizona, New Mexico, Colorado and Utah.
Giant had net earnings of $17 million in 1996 on revenues of $500 million. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
